articles.title: MOVA Rover X10 robot pool cleaner review - impressive unit that can take over the pool care and cleaning duties
articles.text:
- RATING
MOVA Rover X10 (love its rhyming name) it's a seriously impressive unit that can completely take over your pool cleaning duties produce stunning results. It's an investment in giving you back your time and pool.
Anyone who owns a pool knows looking after it is a year-round job. The new MOVA Rover X10 robot pool cleaner help you make light work of it. In fact it will take over completely.
This premium seven-in-one robot pool cleaner and surface skimmer can completely take over your pool maintenance.
It has quadruple motors that generate 38,000 LPH suction and FloatDrive propulsion so it can clean not only the floors and walls but also the steps and other shallow areas and skim the surface.
The EdgeDrive brush can get into edges and corners provide a thorough clean while the 360-degree AquaScan LDS (laser distance sensor) that maps your pool.
PoolNavi also does the heavy lifting in terms of dynamic route planning to get around and clean your pool thoroughly.
It can handle seven zones in your pool: the surface, floor, walls, corners, waterline, steps and shallow zones.
Under the hood are 15 motors that are coordinated to navigate your pool with 4 motors dedicated to smooth vertical hovering.
Tech Guide tested the MOVA Rover X10 robot pool cleaner and setup was easy.
It was just a matter of unpacking it and connecting it to the MOVAhome app.
Also included is a remote-controlled float that connects to your Wi-Fi and uses an ultrasound signal communicate to the robot while it’s underwater to give you real-time monitoring and control.
The unit itself is quite large (it’s 54cm long, 46cm wide and 32cm thick) and heavy (it’s 15.8kg) and requires a bit of strength to manage.
When it’s connected you can choose, either on the unit itself or within the app, whether you want to do the complete clean or choose just the floors or the walls.
We chose everything and threw it in the deep end of our pool.
Took a few minutes to fill up with water and sink to the bottom but once it did, we were off to the races.
The pool we used it in was about 8m long and about 3m wide so it was nothing the MOVA Rover X10 couldn’t handle.
We know for a fact could effortlessly clean and maintain a much bigger swimming pool.
A single charge, you can cover 500 square metres.
It’s suited to all types of pool surfaces whether it’s marble, PVC, ceramic, stainless steel, fibreglass, mosaic tiling or concrete.
Thanks to the intelligent mapping it can also handle all types of pool shapes as well.
The Rover X10 has a 5 L filter basket and has replaceable ultrafine filters to capture everything from leaves to fine particles.
Once it has finished it’s clean. It’s easy to pop open the top panel, remove the basket, and empty it to get it ready for the next clean.
Is a 15,000mAh lithium-ion battery which adds up to about 6 hours of continuous cleaning.
What we liked about the MOVA Rover X10 was the fact that it was a set-and-forget system.
Once it’s in the pool you can leave it and trust it to do its thing.
There are two signs to see that the clean is finished.
First your pool is sparkling clean with no leaves or any surface mess to be seen.
Second, the robot empties itself of water and floats to the surface.
Other robot pool cleaners require the user to drag it from the bottom of the pool with a special hook.
This takes a bit of effort and the added water inside the robot makes it much heavier.
With the X10 at least the water has been released so it can float to the surface to make easier retrieval before you place it back on the charging stand, ready for next time.
Still 15.8kg is not ideal for some customers who may not be able to handle the size and weight of the robot.
One other thing we learned was not to have the filter on while the robot is in the pool.
The robot itself is okay. It can go about its merry way.
But the remote control float would wind up in the filter box.
The other thing to discuss is the price.
Now to be clear, this is a thoroughly efficient pool cleaning robot that can do everything.
But it is priced at $3,699.
What you need to consider is the amount of time this would give back to a pool owner.
Anyone who owns a pool knows it takes a lot of work to maintain all year round.
Some even employ dedicated pool cleaners to come and do the work for them.
The MOVA Rover X10 can be your new dedicated pool cleaner, which, if you had employed someone to do the work for you, will pay itself off in no time.
VERDICT
MOVA Rover X10 (love its rhyming name) it’s a seriously impressive unit that can completely take over your pool cleaning duties produce stunning results. It’s an investment in giving you back your time and pool.

articles.title: VC funding rebounds as startups raise $255M; Women founders driving social change
articles.text:
VC funding rebounds as startups raise $255M; Women founders driving social change
Venture capital funding in Indian startups saw a sharp rise this week, propped up by a couple of deals in the $50-million range.
Dear Reader,
India’s startup funding landscape showed signs of recovery in the third week of November, with investments jumping to $255 million from $26 million in the previous week. AI, retail, food brands and spacetech attracted investor interest, although large-ticket deals remained limited.
Meanwhile, quantum computing is beginning to show promise beyond theoretical research, with companies exploring how the technology could transform the energy sector. From optimising power grids and improving solar cell efficiency to advancing hydrogen production, quantum computers could help tackle some of the industry's most complex challenges.
However, technological advances also bring new challenges. The International Committee of the Red Cross has warned that the world is running out of time to regulate autonomous weapons as AI-powered military technologies advance rapidly. It is urging governments to agree on legally binding international rules to prevent machines from making life-and-death decisions without meaningful human control.
In other news, the global conversation on technology and sustainability continues at the policy level. COP31 climate talks in Turkey ended without consensus following disagreements over the pace of the clean-energy transition, fossil fuel commitments and climate finance for developing nations. The outcome highlights the growing challenge of balancing energy security, economic priorities and climate action.
Closer home, Meta is facing scrutiny over content moderation after the Congress party's youth wing staged protests outside its offices in Hyderabad, Mumbai and Gurugram over the removal of Instagram accounts belonging to party leaders. The protests have reignited concerns around online censorship, free speech and the accountability of social media platforms in India.
In today’s newsletter:
- VC funding bounces back after record low last week
- Women founders using AI to drive social change
Here’s your trivia for today: Which venture capital firm was an early investor in both Google and Amazon? (Scroll down for the answer)
Funding
VC funding bounces back after record low last week
India’s startup funding landscape showed signs of recovery in the third week of November, with investments jumping to $255 million from $26 million in the previous week. Investor interest returned across sectors, with AI, retail, food brands and spacetech attracting capital. However, the broader funding environment continues to face challenges, with large-ticket deals remaining limited.
Key takeaways:
- AI-native CRM startup Dreamteam raised $53 million, while value fashion retailer Style Union secured $52.1 million. Physical AI startup Humyn Labs followed with a $47 million round.
- Semiconductor startup Bharat Semi raised $24 million, food brand Boba Bhai secured $18 million, and robotics startup Botsync attracted $11 million.
- Only 16 deals have crossed the $100 million mark so far in 2026, pointing to continued challenges in large-scale fundraising.
Women Entrepreneurs
These women founders are using AI and emerging technologies to drive social change
From helping girls explore STEM careers to creating digital work opportunities in rural communities, women founders are finding innovative applications for emerging technologies. VigyanShaala is using its Curie Bot to encourage girls from underserved communities to pursue STEM, while Karya is enabling rural workers to earn through AI training projects that incorporate regional languages.
Key takeaways:
- Rocket Learning uses AI to support early childhood education, while Aaroogya AI Foundation applies AI to improve women's health assessments.
- BrainSightAI uses AI-powered brain imaging to help doctors understand neurological and psychiatric conditions.
- Humble Bee uses technology to help small-scale beekeepers improve hive management and productivity, while other ventures are using technology to expand access to education and healthcare.
News & updates
- Gaming Record: Grand Theft Auto VI generated a staggering $3.79 billion in retail sales on its first day, with publisher Rockstar Games calling it the biggest entertainment launch in history. The game sold 32.5 million units before release, while its opening-day revenue nearly quintupled the $800 million earned by its predecessor, GTA V, in 2013.
- Financial Reforms: The Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) has proposed 15 financial sector reforms to strengthen India's financial system and support its ambition of becoming a $26.5 trillion economy by 2047. Key recommendations include a permanent liquidity window for well-governed NBFCs, higher lending limits for renewable energy projects, greater foreign investment in public sector banks and improved access to credit for MSMEs.
What you should watch out for
India Analytics & AI Conference 2026 will be held on November 23 at Conrad Bengaluru, organised by the Institute of Analytics (IoA). The invitation-only event is free to attend and is expected to bring together over 200 participants.
Civo Navigate India 2026 will take place on November 24 at the Sheraton Grand Bengaluru Whitefield Hotel & Convention Center, bringing together over 1,000 technology professionals and 20+ speakers. The conference will explore developments in AI, cloud infrastructure, DevOps and data sovereignty.

articles.title: Un bug permet de jouer à GTA 6 à 60 fps (mais ne testez pas)
articles.text:
Avant le lancement de GTA 6, disponible depuis le 19 novembre sur PS5, Xbox Series S et Xbox Series X, Rockstar Games avait donné, le 10 novembre, quelques détails techniques sur le jeu. On a alors appris une mauvaise nouvelle : GTA 6 vise les 30 images par seconde sur toutes les consoles, même la plus puissante (la PS5 Pro). Même pas de mode 40 fps pour gagner un peu de confort. Rockstar Games justifie ce choix par le niveau de détail qu’il veut garder dans Leonida, des décors aux personnages qui les peuplent.
Fort heureusement, les 30 images par seconde proposées par GTA 6 sont correctement gérées, avec un rendu vraiment optimisé par Rockstar Games. Le titre, pourtant immense, est très beau et tient bien ses 30 images par seconde. Pour les adeptes de la fluidité à tout prix, il existe un bug pour débloquer le framerate. Numerama l’a testé, et on le déconseille.
La version Xbox de GTA 6 peut dépasser les 30 fps, mais…
Ce bug touche la version Xbox de GTA 6, et ne fonctionne que si la console est reliée à un téléviseur compatible 120 Hz. Découvert sur Xbox Series X, il marche aussi sur Xbox Series S, comme l’a montré la chaîne Fuzion Xbox Testing, relayée par Pure Xbox. Il a été repéré sur la version 01.002.001 de GTA 6, toujours la plus récente ce lundi 23 novembre, et une future mise à jour pourrait le corriger.
Le bug exploite la fonction Quick Resume, qui permet de mettre plusieurs jeux en suspens, et de reprendre sa partie quasi immédiatement (même après avoir débranché la console).
Pour l’activer, voici la marche à suivre :
- Paramétrer sa console en 60 Hz ;
- Lancer GTA 6 et attendre que les six étoiles apparaissent dans l’introduction (après avoir validé le profil) ;
- Aller dans les paramètres de la console, sans quitter le jeu, et choisir l’option 120 Hz ;
- Lancer un autre jeu depuis le menu rapide, en appuyant sur le bouton Xbox, sans quitter GTA 6 ;
- Revenir sur GTA 6 via le Quick Resume, sans le fermer.
En lançant la partie, vous remarquerez tout de suite le gain en fluidité, même s’il est irrégulier (entre 45 et 90 fps). Seulement voilà, toutes les animations sont accélérées, que ce soit les mouvements des personnages ou ceux des véhicules. Tout porte à croire que la vitesse du jeu est indexée sur le framerate. En somme, si le framerate augmente, la vitesse du jeu aussi. Sur Reddit, Meowwie64, le joueur qui a découvert la manipulation, indique que les cinématiques, elles, gardent leur vitesse normale, et le montre dans un clip. Il précise aussi que la manipulation, quand elle rate, peut à l’inverse bloquer le jeu à 15 fps.
Pour revenir à la normale, il suffit de quitter complètement GTA 6 depuis le menu de la console, puis de le relancer : le jeu retrouve son plafond de 30 images par seconde.
Ce phénomène rappelle un bug de Dark Souls 2 sur PC : à 60 fps, les armes s’usaient deux fois plus vite qu’à 30 fps, car leur usure était liée au framerate. FromSoftware n’a corrigé le problème que bien plus tard, sur PC comme sur la réédition Scholar of the First Sin.

articles.title: GTA 6 sur PC : l'addition salée pour égaler une simple PS5 ou PS5 Pro
articles.text:
GTA 6 est sorti le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, sans version PC officielle : tout au plus des moddeurs disent pouvoir faire tourner sur PC une copie piratée de la version Xbox, hors de tout cadre légal. La question se pose déjà pour ceux qui hésitent entre une console et un PC de jeu : que faut-il pour obtenir la même chose que sur PS5, ou que sur PS5 Pro, et à quel prix ? La réponse tient beaucoup à la crise de la mémoire qui frappe les composants.
Une version PC officielle pourrait toutefois arriver vite : selon quatre sources citées par GamesBeat, Rockstar prévoit de la sortir au premier trimestre 2027, ce que ni le studio ni Take-Two n’ont confirmé. Ce serait un délai très court pour Rockstar : GTA V, sorti sur consoles en septembre 2013, n’était arrivé sur PC qu’en avril 2015, et Red Dead Redemption 2 avait mis environ un an.
Ce que font la PS5 et la PS5 Pro dans GTA 6
Les deux consoles calculent l’image en 1440p (QHD) et tournent à 30 images par seconde, sans mode 60 FPS. La PS5 agrandit l’image en 4K par une simple mise à l’échelle ; la Pro le fait avec PSSR, l’équivalent du DLSS de NVIDIA, pour une image nettement plus fine. La Pro ajoute aussi des ombres en ray tracing et tient mieux ses 30 FPS : elle descend à 24 au pire, quand la PS5 creuse vers le milieu des 20.
La différence tient à la partie graphique, nettement plus puissante sur la Pro. Le processeur, lui, est de la même famille, à peine plus rapide : selon Marc Chambers, de Rockstar, il n’est « pas assez puissant pour faire tourner la simulation complexe du jeu à une fréquence d’images plus élevée ». Selon nos calculs, un PC peut donc égaler l’une ou l’autre avec le même processeur, un Ryzen 5 7500F ou un Core Ultra 5 245KF chez Intel : seule la carte graphique change.
Notre méthode
DF situe la PS5 au niveau d’une RTX 4060. Dans les tests en ray tracing de Tom’s Hardware, qui nous servent d’étalon, cette carte est freinée par ses 8 Go de mémoire vidéo : notre estimation centrale suppose le même handicap que la RTX 4060 Ti, qui gagne 27 % en passant de 8 à 16 Go, et relève la barre d’autant. Pour la Pro, Sony annonce un rendu jusqu’à 45 % plus rapide : nous retenons ce maximum, une hypothèse prudente. Une carte « à la limite » est à moins de 10 % sous la barre. Ce sont des estimations : aucune version PC n’existe pour les vérifier.
Les prix sont ceux du PC complet, monté par vos soins, avec 32 Go de mémoire, boîtier, alimentation et Windows : la première valeur aux prix planchers du marché, la seconde aux prix relevés en boutique (LDLC, Materiel.net, Alternate, du 14 au 21 novembre), sans chercher le panier le moins cher ni toujours vérifier le stock. Côté consoles : 599 € chez Leclerc pour la PS5 sans lecteur de disque, 649 € avec lecteur ; de 800 € chez Auchan à 900 € chez Sony pour la PS5 Pro, en rupture sur la boutique de Sony.
Le PC équivalent à la PS5 et à la PS5 Pro
| Équivalent | Console | Version NVIDIA* | Version AMD* | PC / console | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PS5 ; 1440p à 30 FPS, 4K agrandie | 599 € à 649 € | RTX 5060 Ti 16 Go ; PC complet : 2 100 € à 2 550 € | RX 9060 XT 16 Go ; PC complet : 1 950 € à 2 295 € | 3,0 à 4,3 fois | 
| PS5 Pro ; 1440p à 30 FPS, 4K par PSSR, ombres en ray tracing en plus | 800 € à 900 € | RTX 5070 12 Go (à la limite : RTX 5060 Ti 16 Go) ; PC complet : 2 200 € à 2 483 € | RX 9070 16 Go (à la limite : RX 9070 GRE 12 Go) ; PC complet : 2 120 € à 2 463 € | 2,4 à 3,1 fois | 
* Ryzen 5 7500F, 32 Go de DDR5-6000, SSD de 1 To, carte mère B650, alimentation 80+ Gold et Windows 11 Famille. Estimation Frandroid pour GTA 6
Sécurisez vos achats durant Black Friday avec la meilleure offre de l’année. Dénichez les bonnes affaires, Bitdefender s’occupe des arnaques.
Aux prix planchers, le PC équivalent à la PS5 Pro ne coûte que 100 à 170 € de plus que celui qui égale la PS5. Le processeur, la mémoire, le SSD et Windows sont les mêmes ; seule la carte graphique change. Comme la Pro coûte nettement plus cher que la PS5 (800 à 900 € contre 599 à 649 €), l’écart avec le PC se réduit.
Pourquoi si peu d’écart ? Les cartes moins chères qui s’approchent de la PS5 n’ont que 8 Go de mémoire vidéo, un pari risqué pour GTA 6 : la première carte qui passe sans ce pari a 16 Go, et elle est déjà proche de la Pro. Notre PC « équivalent PS5 » fait donc mieux que la console : dans nos calculs, la RX 9060 XT 16 Go dépasse la barre de 14 %, la RTX 5060 Ti 16 Go de 44 %.
Pour la PS5 Pro, notre estimation centrale part du gain maximal annoncé par Sony (un rendu 45 % plus rapide que sur la PS5) : l’égaler demande une RX 9070 16 Go chez AMD ou une RTX 5070 12 Go chez NVIDIA, avec le même processeur que pour la PS5 (Ryzen 5 7500F, ou Core Ultra 5 245KF chez Intel) : celui de la Pro a la même architecture, avec une fréquence pouvant augmenter de 10 %.
PC complet : 2 120 € à 2 463 € en version AMD, 2 200 € à 2 483 € en version NVIDIA, soit 2,4 à 3,1 fois le prix de la console (800 € à 900 €). Si la Pro est moins puissante que ce maximum, une RX 9070 GRE 12 Go ou une RTX 5060 Ti 16 Go suffiraient ; Digital Foundry place même la RX 9060 XT 16 Go et la RTX 5060 Ti 16 Go au niveau de la Pro, dans d’autres jeux. Notre calcul ne compte pas le coût des ombres en ray tracing propres à la Pro : sans version PC, impossible de le mesurer.
Selon la boutique, la carte du PC « équivalent PS5 Pro » peut même coûter moins cher que celle du PC « équivalent PS5 » : le 20 novembre, Materiel.net affichait la RTX 5060 Ti 16 Go à 1 030 € et la RTX 5070 12 Go à 1 000 € ; Alternate vendait cette dernière 933 €.
Pour aller plus loin
Quelles sont les meilleures cartes graphiques de 2026 ? Le comparatif et classement des RTX 50, RX 9000
Où passe l’argent
Voici le détail du PC équivalent à la PS5, en version AMD. La carte graphique n’est plus la seule pièce chère : la mémoire vive pèse presque autant.
| Pièce | Prix (plancher du marché à prix en boutique) | 
|---|---|
| Processeur Ryzen 5 7500F | 180 € | 
| Carte graphique RX 9060 XT 16 Go | 650 € à 745 € | 
| Ventirad | 35 € | 
| Carte mère B650 | 115 € | 
| Mémoire vive : 32 Go de DDR5-6000 | 499 € à 650 € | 
| SSD NVMe 1 To | 151 € à 190 € | 
| Boîtier | 50 € à 90 € | 
| Windows 11 Famille | 170 € | 
| Alimentation 750 W 80+ Gold | 100 € à 120 € | 
| Total | 1 950 € à 2 295 € | 
La faute à la crise de la mémoire : selon un suivi de ComputerBase relayé par Overclocking.com, les kits de DDR5 ont pris en moyenne 446 % depuis la mi-septembre 2025, certains coûtent plus de six fois leur prix initial, et certains SSD se vendent trois fois plus cher.
Les cartes graphiques ont aussi pris environ 35 % en trois mois, selon une enquête de Hardware Unboxed sur dix pays (la France n’en fait pas partie), relayée par GinjFo. Les prix en boutique dépassent souvent de beaucoup le plancher du marché : la RX 9070 XT trouvée à 933 € au plus bas en coûte 1 330 € chez LDLC.
Pour alléger la note, retirez 170 € si vous avez déjà une licence Windows. Envisager 16 Go de mémoire plutôt que 32 réduirait aussi la facture (un kit de 16 Go de DDR5-5600 était affiché 300 € chez LDLC, contre 499 € au mieux pour 32 Go de DDR5-6000), mais on ne sait pas si 16 Go suffiront à GTA 6 sur PC : ceux de la PS5 sont partagés entre processeur et carte graphique.
Pour aller plus loin
Quelles sont les meilleures barrettes de RAM (DDR5, DDR4) pour votre PC en 2026 ?
Et si vous avez déjà un PC ?
Si votre PC repose déjà sur une plateforme AM4 en DDR4, la facture baisse nettement : 32 Go de mémoire y coûtent de 185 à 330 €, et un Ryzen 7 5800X3D devrait suffire pour le 30 FPS de la console, selon nos estimations.
Changer la seule carte graphique peut alors suffire pour jouer comme sur PS5 : notre article sur la configuration nécessaire pour GTA 6 sur PC détaille, carte par carte, ce que donneront les modèles les plus courants.
Ce que le PC offre en plus
Pour jouer à GTA 6 en 30 FPS, la console reste bien moins chère à l’achat, et sans abonnement PlayStation Plus à prévoir, le jeu n’ayant pas de mode en ligne pour l’instant. Le PC sert à bien d’autres choses, et garde un avantage que ni la PS5 ni la Pro n’offrent : viser 60 images par seconde.
Mais cela demande un processeur bien plus rapide que celui des consoles, comme un Ryzen 7 7800X3D (chez Intel, le Core i9-14900K reste tout juste en dessous dans nos calculs), et le prix grimpe d’autant : comptez 2 979 € à 3 417 € en version NVIDIA et 2 582 € à 2 879 € en version AMD pour notre configuration 60 FPS, en QHD avec des creux. Nous détaillons aussi la configuration à viser pour le 60 FPS, en tour comme en PC portable.

articles.title: Retter in der Antibiotika-Krise? Warum diese Viren Bakterienkiller sein könnten
articles.text:
Retter in der Antibiotika-Krise? Warum diese Viren Bakterienkiller sein könnten
Viren, die Bakterien töten, gelten als Hoffnungsträger in der Antibiotika-Krise. Die sogenannten Bakteriophagen, kurz „Phagen“, bieten auch jenen Bakterien Paroli, gegen die gängige Mittel nichts mehr ausrichten können. Allein in Deutschland sterben laut Schätzungen des Robert Koch-Instituts (RKI) jedes Jahr 10.000 Menschen an diesen resistenten Keimen.
Maria Vehreschild und ihr Team an der Universitätsmedizin Frankfurt arbeiten schon seit Jahren mit den viralen Bakterienkillern. Sie waren auch maßgeblich an den kürzlich veröffentlichten Leitlinien zur personalisierten Phagentherapie beteiligt. Die Infektiologin erklärt, was dahintersteckt, welche anderen Therapieansätze es noch gibt und ob KI als Treiber wirken kann.
MIT Technology Review: In manchen Ländern – etwa in Georgien oder Russland – hat die Phagentherapie schon eine lange Geschichte. In Deutschland hingegen ist vielen nicht einmal der Begriff „Phage“ bekannt. Was zeichnet diesen Virustyp aus?
Maria Vehreschild: Phagen töten Bakterien, und zwar spezifisch nur eine bestimmte Bakterienart. Das unterscheidet sie von Antibiotika, die oft verschiedenste Bakterien-Spezies abtöten, auch die guten. Damit richten Antibiotika am Mikrobiom viele Kollateralschäden an, die krankmachen können. Und was außerdem passieren kann: Innerhalb meines eigentlich gesunden Mikrobioms können resistente Bakterien durch das Antibiotikum hochselektiert werden. Sie dominieren dann mein Mikrobiom und können bei einem geschwächten Immunsystem zur echten Gefahr werden. Bei Phagen hingegen sind weder Kollateralschäden noch Selektionsdruck vorhanden.

articles.title: Paso a paso para invertir en criptomonedas y cuál es su valor este lunes 23 de noviembre
articles.text:
Las criptomonedas son un activo digital innovador que han experimentado un crecimiento monumental en los últimos tiempos debido a varios elementos que contribuyen a ello, entre ellos que algunos gobiernos hayan decidido darles una oportunidad como moneda de curso legal; no obstante, también han sufrido descalabros que han puesto en duda su viabilidad, como el más reciente episodio conocido como el "criptoinvierno".
Pese a este panorama, cada vez más personas han empezado a adquirir criptomonedas para poder invertir en algo "seguro" y "fiable" tanto a corto como a largo plazo, a pesar de los niveles extremos de inestabilidad que sufre constantemente.
Sin embargo, invertir o comprar en criptodivisas es más fácil de lo que parece. Hay que recordar que se trata de monedas virtuales, por lo que serán controladas en carteras o monederos que comparten esa particularidad, pues a diferencia del dinero corriente, no tienen un soporte físico.
El precio de las criptomonedas hoy
Esta es la cotización de las criptodivisas más destacadas en este momento.
El Bitcoin, cotiza a 61.122,54 dólares, lo que implicó un cambio de -0,064% en las últimas horas.
La segunda criptomoneda más popular del mercado, Ethereum, ha mostrado un movimiento de -0,183% en las últimas 24 horas, por lo que su valor se ubica en 1.717,92 dólares.
En el caso de TetherUs, su precio es de 1 dólares, por lo que en el último día tuvo un movimiento de 0,08%.
Por su parte, BNB, tiene un valor de 555,47 dólares, con un cambio de 1,45%, en cambio el Litecoin cotizó a 40.506 dólares, tras una variación de 1.9479462.
Finalmente, el Dogecoin, una de las monedas virtuales que fue impulsada por Elon Musk, tiene un valor de 0,06 dólares tras presentar un cambio de 0,46% en las últimas 24 horas.
Qué pasa con las criptodivisas
Luego de que en las primeras semanas de mayo del 2022 se viviera el "criptocrash" o "criptoinvierno" que dejaron al descubierto la enorme volatilidad de estas monedas digitales, ha llegado un nuevo periodo de relativa estabilidad.
Bitcoin, ethereum y BNB han mostrado variaciones "controladas", puesto que no se han disparado los precios como en semanas previas. Por ejemplo, a inicios de agosto, las mencionadas anteriormente tuvieron un cambio menor del 2%.
Por otra parte, algo que esta llamando la atención en el mundo de las criptomonedas es que China está ablandando sus restricciones y podría comenzar a permitir su uso. Específicamente sería Hong Kong en donde este cambio se haría presente.
Sumado a ello, la plataforma de transacciones digitales PayPal anunció su propia stablecoin llamada PayPal USD (PYUSD), que cuenta por el respaldo de depósitos en dólares, bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos a corto plazo y activos equivalentes.
La compañía ha afirmado en su declaración que permitirá la transferencia de fondos a monederos digitales de terceros y proporcionará detalles sobre cómo integrar su servicio en exchanges centralizados y descentralizados, con el objetivo de ser utilizado en Finanzas Descentralizadas (DeFi, por sus siglas en inglés). Por lo tanto, es muy probable que se utilice ampliamente en la industria Web3.
Su avance en Latinoamérica
Criptomonedas en México: el Banco de México (Banxico) ha determinado que ninguna de las instituciones que participan en el sistema financiero nacional podrá hacer uso o deberá permitir operaciones de ninguna clase a través de este medio de pago.
En territorio mexicano el empresario Ricardo Salinas Pliego, uno de los más ricos del país, ha mostrado interés en las criptomonedas y ha asegurado que varios de sus negocios aceptarán bitcoin en el futuro, incluido su banco; hasta el momento una de sus tiendas más populares ya lo hace.
Criptomonedas en Perú: el Banco Central de Reserva del Perú (BCR) ha dejado en claro que su misión no es ser el primero ni el segundo banco central que regule el uso de las criptomonedas, ello debido a la inestabilidad que las caracteriza. Sin embargo, hace días el presidente del (BCR) aseguró que el BCR trabajaba en un proyecto de moneda digital propia.
Criptomonedas en Colombia: en la nación sudamericana hay más de 500 sitios donde es permitido pagar con criptodivisas. Colombia ocupa el puesto 14 entre 26 países de adopción de criptomonedas, según el informe de Finder.
Criptomonedas en Centroamérica: en el gobierno de El Salvador, el bitcoin, que en septiembre de 2021 se convirtió en moneda de curso legal, ha perdido oficialmente este estatus en este enero del 2025 tras una reforma aprobada por la Asamblea Legislativa del país. Según informó la prensa local, la modificación de la Ley Bitcoin fue impulsada por el gobierno del presidente Nayib Bukele y respaldada por la mayoría oficialista en el órgano legislativo. Este cambio marca el fin de una política que había colocado al país centroamericano en el centro del debate global sobre las criptomonedas.
¿Cómo crear una criptomoneda?
Al momento de crear una criptomoneda es importante primero determinar qué se desea tener: una moneda o un token. La primera usa su propia blockchain, mientras que la segunda se basa en una red preexistente.
De acuerdo con el sitio de Binance, para crear una criptomoneda se necesita de un gran equipo de desarrolladores y expertos; mientras que para el token sí se requieren conocimientos técnicos pero es posible crearlo en minutos a través del uso de otras blockchains como Ethereum o BNB, que son las más populares.
Los costos de creación, el tiempo requerido y el uso de fuerza de trabajo dependerá de si se opta por hacer una moneda virtual o un token. En éste último caso también se puede usar un código establecido para crear tokens o pagar para usar un servicio de creación de monedas.
Es importante saber que antes de crear una criptomoneda se debe considerar su utilidad y estado legal.
En el caso de elegir crear una criptomoneda, entonces se debe elegir una blockchain, posteriormente se debe hacer un plan acorde al funcionamiento y la funcionalidad de la blockchain para diseñar los nodos y la interfaz.

articles.title: GlobeTopper loses $2.5 million after hackers steal $70k in gift cards
articles.text:
A cyberattack disrupted operations at B2B top-up solutions provider GlobeTopper, causing an estimated $2.5 million in lost revenue, while the attacker redeemed digital gift cards worth $70,000.
Parent company iQSTEL said that the intrusion was detected on October 22 and GlobeTopper responded by suspending its platform and starting an investigation.
GlobeTopper is a business-to-business digital gift card distributor. Various retailers, fintech apps, and rewards platforms use its API. According to the platform’s website, it is used by more than 4,000 brands across 65 countries, including IKEA, Adidas, Spotify, Target, and Roblox.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), iQSTEL said that GlobeTopper detected more unauthorized activity the day after it identified the attack. In response, the company "took the platform and all affected servers offline" in the early hours of October 23 to investigate and fix the problem.
The company deployed a completely rebuilt platform on AWS on October 31, while commercial operations were restored in stages, starting November 1.
GlobeTopper says the attacker obtained certain client API credentials and integration keys, which have been revoked and replaced, and it has observed no unauthorized use of them yet.
“During its investigation, the Company determined that the unauthorized party obtained API credentials and integration keys of certain GlobeTopper business customers,” iQSTEL says.
“All affected credentials and integration keys have been revoked and rotated, and affected business customers have been issued new credentials subject to additional access restrictions.”
The company further stated that an investigation is ongoing to determine whether other customer, personal, payment, or provider data was accessed or acquired.
Regarding the digital gift cards the attackers redeemed, the company says it cannot block, recover, or reclaim them, and will incur the losses.
iQSTEL said the incident hurt GlobeTopper’s fourth-quarter transaction volume and operating results, but as of the filing, it has not determined it to be material.
BleepingComputer has emailed iQSTEL with additional questions regarding the incident, but the company declined to share further information.
At the time of writing, no ransomware groups have listed iQSTEL or GlobeTopper as victims on their extortion portals.

articles.title: Durante las excavaciones arqueológicas en la Duna de Pilat, estos científicos descubrieron restos que datan de la Edad del Hierro
articles.text:
Un grupo de arqueólogos ha encontrado restos de la Edad del Hierro en la duna de Pilat, situada en la región francesa de Gironda. El descubrimiento tuvo lugar durante unas excavaciones realizadas entre el 21 de septiembre y el 9 de octubre de 2026, en las que participaron investigadores y voluntarios. Entre los objetos encontrados hay piezas de cerámica, algunas de ellas especialmente bien conservadas.
De hecho, el arqueólogo Philippe Jacques explicó que habían recuperado una vasija prácticamente completa, desde la base hasta el cuello, algo que no suele ser habitual en este tipo de excavaciones. Sin embargo, lo más interesante llegó cuando encontraron varios objetos relacionados con la pesca, entre ellos un flotador, una piedra utilizada como peso para las redes y lo que podrían ser fragmentos de una herramienta para repararlas.
Un descubrimiento que aporta nuevas pistas sobre la zona
¿Y por qué es importante este hallazgo? Porque, como explica Jacques en unas declaraciones difundidas por el organismo que gestiona la duna de Pilat, hasta ahora no habían encontrado pruebas de actividades pesqueras durante la Edad del Hierro en esa parte de la costa francesa. Los restos permiten conocer un poco mejor cómo vivían las personas que habitaban la zona hace miles de años.
Pero las sorpresas no terminaron ahí. En la parte norte del antiguo espacio dedicado a producir sal, los investigadores también localizaron agujeros de postes y varias fosas que apuntan a la existencia de al menos un edificio. Una construcción que todavía permanece enterrada bajo la zona oriental de la duna y que los arqueólogos esperan seguir investigando durante los próximos años.

articles.title: Pour le Black Friday 2026, l'aspirateur robot Dyson R2 Nurovi passe à 469 € (-30 %)
articles.text:
Black Friday 2026 : L'aspirateur robot Dyson R2 Nurovi Wash+Dry à 469,00 € (-30%)
Actuellement noté 3,5/5 par notre rédaction, l'aspirateur robot Dyson R2 Nurovi Wash+Dry assure un nettoyage efficace sur les sols durs et franchit des obstacles mesurant jusqu'à 4 cm. Le Black Friday 2026 fait descendre son prix à 469,00 € chez Amazon, soit une baisse d'environ 30 % et 202,67 € d'économie.
Dyson cherche à se repositionner sur le secteur des robots d'entretien avec le Dyson R2 Nurovi Wash+Dry, un appareil tout-en-un pensé pour le nettoyage quotidien des sols durs. Ce modèle s'est distingué lors de son passage dans notre labo par son efficacité d'aspiration et sa station sans sac qui réduit les coûts d'entretien.
À l'occasion du Black Friday, cet aspirateur robot descend à 469,00 € chez Amazon, soit environ 30 % de moins que le prix moyen constaté ces 30 derniers jours (671,67 €). Cette baisse de prix permet d'économiser 202,67 €.
Une aspiration efficace sur sols durs et un franchissement maîtrisé
Sur le banc d'essai, le Dyson R2 Nurovi Wash+Dry assure un ramassage soigné des poussières sur les surfaces dures et dans les fentes de parquet, tout en maintenant un niveau sonore contenu à pleine puissance. Sa motricité lui permet de surmonter des seuils ou des obstacles mesurant jusqu'à 4 cm, ce qui évite les blocages récurrents entre deux pièces. Pour en savoir plus sur son comportement, vous pouvez consulter notre test complet. En matière d'endurance, l'appareil affiche une autonomie mesurée de 142 minutes en mode normal, pour une durée de recharge de 158 minutes.
Dyson R2 Nurovi Wash+Dry
Points forts
- Excellente aspiration sur sols durs et fentes de parquet.
- Bruit bien contenu à pleine puissance.
- Franchissement d'obstacles jusqu'à 4 cm.
- Bon indice de réparabilité et démontage facile.
Points faibles
- Performances de lavage limitées.
- Réservoirs d'eau et bac à poussière trop petits.
- Finitions un peu légères pour un produit Dyson.
- Application mobile pauvre en réglages.
NB : La baisse de prix rapportée est calculée en comparant le prix le plus bas du jour avec la moyenne des prix les plus bas pratiqués par tous les marchands pour le produit le mois dernier, avec des règles de sécurité pour écarter les prix des boutiques dont la politique en matière de TVA n’est pas claire (dites boutiques “grises”, typiquement en cas d’import de Chine).
Des concessions sur le lavage et l'autonomie des réservoirs
Actuellement noté 3,5/5 par notre rédaction, l'appareil montre ses limites sur la partie serpillière à patins, qui peine à éliminer les taches incrustées sur les sols. La taille réduite du bac à poussière et des réservoirs d'eau impose de nombreux allers-retours vers la station de charge, allongeant la durée globale du cycle de nettoyage. L'application mobile fait quant à elle l'impasse sur plusieurs réglages avancés et les finitions s'avèrent perfectibles. Ce modèle s'adresse ainsi en priorité aux personnes qui cherchent avant tout une aspiration automatique performante sur sol dur, en acceptant un lavage d'appoint.
Narwal Flow : l'autre option face au Dyson R2 Nurovi Wash+Dry
Le Narwal Flow mise sur une efficacité de nettoyage plus complète pour l'entretien du foyer, capable d'aspirer la poussière mais aussi d'éliminer les taches au sol plus activement que le système à patins de Dyson. En revanche, le modèle de Narwal recourt à des sacs à poussière non recyclables pour sa station, quand le R2 Nurovi Wash+Dry s'appuie sur une conception sans sac et des pièces facilement remplaçables.
Le Narwal Flow est vendu 539,00 €, soit 70,00 € plus cher que le Dyson R2 Nurovi Wash+Dry à son tarif remisé, mais il bénéficie d'une note actuelle de 5/5 grâce à ses meilleures performances de lavage.
Narwal Flow
Points forts
- Excellent franchisseur d'obstacle.
- Belles performances d'aspiration.
- Lavage efficace.
- Entretien simplissime.
Points faibles
- Lent pour finir sa mission.
- Passe parfois un peu trop au large des objets qui traînent.
- Quelques intitulés peu clairs dans l'app.
- Sac à poussière non recyclable.

articles.title: Google dá prazo para apps de Android ganharem versões dobráveis
articles.text:
Google dá prazo para apps de Android ganharem versões dobráveis
Apps que não se adequarem às regras de telas dobráveis perderão o direito de publicar novas versões e terão menos alcance na Google Play Store.
O Google determinou que, a partir de abril de 2027, desenvolvedores atendam ao Nível 3 (Tier 3) das diretrizes de qualidade adaptável do Android para dispositivos dobráveis. Na prática, isso significa que um app não poderá funcionar de modo improvisado quando expandido para uma tela maior.
Talvez você já tenha passado pela experiência de usar um app em celular convencional e, ao abri-lo em um smartphone dobrável ou até em um tablet, notar que ele ficou com elementos desalinhados ou com grandes áreas não aproveitadas, por exemplo. É justamente esse tipo de situação que o Google quer evitar com as novas diretrizes.
Para tanto, há uma série de exigências a serem seguidas. Uma delas determina que a interface do aplicativo continue funcional quando houver mudança de orientação ou de dimensões, o que ocorre quando o usuário abre ou fecha a tela dobrável.
Outra exigência determina que o app ocupe de modo adequado o espaço oferecido por uma tela expandida, não podendo exibir seu conteúdo como se estivesse em um celular convencional (com visor estreito). Vai além: o aplicativo também deve suportar modos de múltiplas janelas.
Também a partir de abril de 2027, os desenvolvedores deverão fornecer pelo menos três capturas de tela de seus aplicativos registradas em celulares dobráveis, de modo que os usuários possam verificar, já na Google Play Store, como eles funcionam com diferentes configurações de tela.
O Google comenta as novas exigências:
Ao investir nesses dispositivos de última geração, os usuários esperam que os apps e jogos favoritos ofereçam uma transição perfeita e suave entre os estados dobrado e desdobrado, além de novas experiências que só são possíveis em telas dobráveis.
Mekka Okereke, gerente geral de apps na Google Play Store
Os aplicativos que não seguirem as condições do chamado Nível 3 não poderão ter novas versões disponibilizadas na Google Play Store, muito menos publicarem atualizações.
Note que os aplicativos já disponíveis na loja serão mantidos por lá, mas poderão ter sua visibilidade reduzida se não atenderem às novas regras.
Observe que o Nível 3 consiste em um conjunto básico de novas regras. Com o passar do tempo, os desenvolvedores deverão adequar os seus aplicativos ao Nível 2 e ao Nível 1:
- Nível 2: o aplicativo deve suportar layouts responsivos com múltiplos painéis, evitando elementos esticados desproporcionalmente, bem como oferecer suporte básico a acessórios como teclado, mouse e trackpad;
- Nível 1: deve permitir usos em modos livro e mesa (com o aparelho parcialmente dobrado), continuidade da câmera, picture-in-picture interativo, entre outros.
Os Níveis 2 e 1 não são obrigatórios, razão pela qual ainda não têm prazo de adoção. Porém, eles deverão fazer parte do programa de qualidade da Google Play Store em algum momento, quando então serão exigidos.

articles.title: GTA VI player gets 30-day PSN suspension for sharing screenshot of in-game nudity with friend
articles.text:
WTF?! Here's an important reminder for anyone who uses messages over the PlayStation Network: don't send any nude images, even if they come from a video game. One GTA VI player discovered the consequences of breaking this rule when they sent a picture of the game's nudist colony, taken with the in-game camera. His punishment was a 30-day suspension from the PSN's social features.
X user DerrickGott007 posted the notification he received from PlayStation, along with a warning not to send images that contain nudity. He sent a friend an image of GTA VI's nudist beach, which the company says breached its code of conduct set out in its terms of service. It classifies the offending content as pornographic or obscene, earning him a month-long ban.
There's also a warning that any offenses may result in temporary or permanent suspension from the whole of PlayStation, not just the PSN social features.
 – DerrickGott007💎 (@derrickgott007) November 20, 2026
PlayStation's code of conduct lists several types of prohibited content, which apply to text, images, videos, and links sent in private chats or group messages. The explicit or graphic media section notes that sharing sexually explicit, nude, or excessively violent images/videos can trigger bans, even if captured from an age-restricted game and sent to a friend, which is what happened in this case.
It does seem strange to apply these rules to content found in a game, especially one that is now driving up sales of the PlayStation 5 and PS5 Pro, but the company says this sort of action is necessary to protect PlayStation and its players, apparently.
GTA VI, of course, has lived up to the pre-release hype. Take-Two confirmed that day-one retail sales of Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI reached an estimated $3.79 billion, making it the biggest launch in entertainment history.
The latest entry in the long-running franchise has a Metascore of 99, putting it level with Ocarina of Time as the highest-rated game ever. That's quite a contrast to the user score, which stands at just 5.6. A lot of the complaints are over claims that the story and game itself have become too "woke," though there are several mentions of bugs and the 30fps max framerate that can dip even lower at times.
However, with more than 32.5 million pre-orders, the 43.9K negative reviews represent a minuscule fraction of buyers, and Metacritic does not require users to prove they own or have played a game to submit a rating or review.

articles.title: AI-powered bionic eye breakthrough could help the blind see again
articles.text:
AI-powered bionic eye breakthrough could help the blind see again
Using AI to make bionic vision smarter and more precise, scientists are bringing the possibility of restoring sight to people with blindness one step closer to reality.
- Date:
  November 12, 2026
- Source:
  University of California - Santa Barbara
- Summary:
  Scientists have developed an AI-powered approach that makes experimental bionic vision technology more precise, helping predict the flashes and shapes of light perceived by a blind man with a brain implant. By learning how an individual's brain responds to electrical stimulation, the technology could bring researchers closer to restoring some degree of sight to people with blindness.
- Share:
Artificial intelligence could help overcome one of the biggest challenges in restoring vision to people who are blind: getting a brain implant to produce reliable visual experiences. Researchers from three institutions, including UC Santa Barbara, have demonstrated that AI can improve how precisely an experimental visual prosthesis stimulates the brain and predicts what a person perceives.
The team used a deep learning system to develop electrical stimulation patterns for electrodes temporarily implanted in the visual cortex, the region at the back of the brain responsible for processing visual information. By analyzing the brain's responses, the technology gave researchers greater control over neural activity and helped them better anticipate the visual sensations produced by the implant.
Published online in the journal Neuron, the proof-of-concept study represents progress toward more advanced visual prostheses, sometimes described as bionic eyes. These devices could eventually become more effective by learning how each person's brain responds to stimulation rather than relying on predetermined settings.
"Building a model in the abstract is one thing," said Michael Beyeler, an associate professor of computer science and psychological and brain sciences at UC Santa Barbara. "Seeing it shape an experiment with a person is something else entirely. That ability to go from theory to something that may one day help people is what drives much of the work in our lab."
How Bionic Vision Could Bypass Damaged Eyes
For decades, scientists have worked to develop technologies capable of restoring some vision to people who are blind, although the results have generally been limited. Some experimental devices stimulate the retina, the layer of tissue at the back of the eye that detects light. Others attempt to activate parts of the visual system farther along the pathway that carries visual information to the brain.
Visual cortical prostheses work differently. Instead of depending on the eyes or optic nerves, they deliver electrical signals directly to the visual cortex. This approach could offer a potential solution for people whose visual pathways have been damaged but whose visual cortex can still respond to stimulation. Possible candidates include individuals who lost their sight because of strokes, neurodegenerative diseases, or traumatic brain injuries.
The ability to regain even limited vision could be especially meaningful for people who remember what it was like to see.
Beyeler highlighted those "who have been able to see for part of their life, but then, because of an inherited eye disease or an accident, have lost their vision," adding, "For those people, the desire may be very strong to get some vision back."
The new findings build on earlier computational research supported by Beyeler's 2022 National Institutes of Health (NIH) Director's New Innovator Award. The five-year, $2 million grant has supported his efforts to make artificial vision systems more accurate, predictable, and effective.
Scientists Test AI With a Brain Implant in a Blind Man
An important opportunity to test the technology came in 2024, when researchers from Beyeler's Bionic Vision Lab traveled to Spain. Their goal was to determine whether their computer models could improve the performance of a brain implant already being used in an experimental study.
At Hospital IMED Elche, the team worked with a 27-year-old man who had become blind following a traumatic brain injury. He had received an implant containing 96 electrodes arranged in an array within his visual cortex. The device was intended to remain in place for six months before being removed.
When researchers activated the electrodes using electrical current, the participant experienced visual sensations known as phosphenes. These can appear as spots, flashes, or shapes of light, sometimes resembling stars or fireworks.
Producing these sensations is possible, but making them consistent and predictable is much more difficult. The same electrical stimulation does not always trigger an identical response, and activating particular electrodes does not guarantee that the person will perceive a specific visual pattern.
To address this problem, the researchers trained a deep neural network, a type of AI designed to recognize complex patterns, to predict how the visual cortex would respond to different electrical stimulation settings. The model also considered the brain's resting activity immediately before stimulation, giving it information about the participant's current neural state.
Using these predictions, the researchers identified combinations of electrical signals that were most likely to produce particular patterns of brain activity.
AI Makes Bionic Vision More Precise
When the scientists tested the stimulation patterns selected by AI, the results were encouraging. The new approach generated the intended patterns of neural activity more accurately than the comparison methods while requiring less electrical current.
Another important discovery emerged when the team examined the relationship between brain activity and the participant's visual experiences. The patterns recorded directly from his brain were better predictors of what he perceived than the stimulation settings themselves.
This distinction matters because activating the brain is not the same as knowing what a person will see. Even when researchers can produce a desired neural response, they still need to understand how the brain transforms that activity into a conscious visual experience.
"Engineers naturally want to treat phosphenes like pixels: stimulate more electrodes, and you should get a more complete image," Beyeler said. "But the brain does not work that way. Electrodes interact, neural responses fluctuate, and what we put into the brain is not necessarily what the person perceives. The challenge is to learn more about that transformation."
The findings suggest that future visual prostheses may need to do more than simply deliver electrical signals. They may also need to monitor how the brain reacts and use that feedback to continually improve stimulation.
Teaching Brain Implants to Adapt to Each Person
A key advantage of the implant used in the experiment was its ability to perform two tasks. It could stimulate the visual cortex with electrical current while simultaneously recording the resulting neural activity.
This allowed researchers to train their AI model using the brain's actual responses rather than relying exclusively on information about which electrodes were activated and how much current they delivered.
The participant also provided feedback about what he experienced. He reported whether he saw a phosphene and, during certain experiments, described its appearance, including its shape, size, brightness, and color.
Comparing these reports with the recorded brain activity revealed that neural responses contained more useful information about the perceived visual sensations than the electrical stimulation parameters alone.
The AI system also used measurements of resting brain activity to account for changes in the participant's neural state before each stimulation. This could be particularly valuable because the brain's response to electrical signals can vary over time, including from one day to the next.
By adapting stimulation to these changing conditions, future prostheses might provide more consistent visual experiences without requiring users to adjust to a rigid set of signals.
"A useful visual prosthesis cannot rely on a fixed recipe," Beyeler said. "It has to learn how an individual brain responds and adapt the stimulation accordingly. Ultimately, the device should adapt to the person, not the other way around."
A Collaborative Step Toward Restoring Sight
The research brought together scientists from UC Santa Barbara, ETH Zurich, and Miguel Hernández University (MHU). Beyeler described the effort as "a true collaboration."
The project was led by co-first authors Pehuén Moure of ETH Zurich, Jacob Granley of UC Santa Barbara, and Fabrizio Grani of MHU. The supervising researchers were Beyeler, Shih-Chii Liu of ETH Zurich, and Eduardo Fernández of MHU. Their work forms part of a larger feasibility trial taking place in Spain.
Although the technology remains experimental and the participant's visual experiences were limited to flashes and shapes of light, the results demonstrate how AI could improve communication between artificial vision devices and the brain.
Rather than treating every brain as if it responds the same way, future bionic vision systems could learn from each individual and adjust their signals accordingly. That personalized approach may prove essential to developing implants that can eventually restore useful vision to people who have lost their sight.
Story Source:
Materials provided by University of California - Santa Barbara. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
Journal Reference:
- Pehuén Moure, Jacob Granley, Fabrizio Grani, Leili Soo, Antonio Lozano, Rocío López-Peco, Adrián Villamarín-Ortiz, Cristina Soto-Sánchez, Shih-Chii Liu, Michael Beyeler, Eduardo Fernández. Deep learning-based control of electrically evoked activity in human visual cortex. Neuron, 2026; DOI: 10.1016/j.neuron.2026.07.006

articles.title: COLORFUL Launches iGame B850I MINI W OC Motherboard for Compact PC Enthusiasts
articles.text:
Monday, November 23rd 2026
COLORFUL Launches iGame B850I MINI W OC Motherboard for Compact PC Enthusiasts
Colorful Technology Company Limited, a leading brand in gaming PC components, gaming laptops, and Hi-fi audio products, announces the launch of the iGame B850I MINI W OC, a white edition of its previously released iGame B850I MINI OC motherboard. Designed for enthusiasts building high-performance small form factor (SFF) systems, the new white model retains the same powerful hardware, overclocking capabilities, and compact Mini-ITX design as its black counterpart, making it an ideal choice for white-themed PC builds.
The original iGame B850I MINI OC has earned recognition among enthusiasts for its industrial-inspired design and impressive overclocking capabilities. Responding to demand for an alternative color scheme, COLORFUL now introduces the iGame B850I MINI W OC, bringing the same performance-focused platform to builders who prefer a clean, all-white aesthetic.9+2+1 Phase Power Design and Advanced Overclocking
The iGame B850I MINI W OC features a robust 9+2+1 phase power delivery design, providing sufficient power to support high-end AMD Ryzen/AMD Ryzen X3D processors, including the AMD Ryzen 9 9950X. It also integrates an external clock generator for asynchronous overclocking, giving enthusiasts greater flexibility when fine-tuning CPU frequencies and system performance.
The motherboard's BIOS also includes COLORFUL's proprietary X3D AI Turbo Mode, which uses one-click optimization to unlock additional gaming performance from AMD Ryzen 9000 Series X3D processors.
Dual PCIe 5.0 M.2 Storage and Extensive Connectivity
Despite its compact Mini-ITX form factor, the iGame B850I MINI W OC offers extensive expansion and connectivity options. It features two onboard PCIe 5.0 M.2 slots for high-speed NVMe storage, alongside eight high-speed USB ports on the rear I/O panel, including a USB-C 20 Gbps connection.
This combination provides connectivity and storage expansion that rivals larger microATX motherboards, making it well-suited to compact gaming systems without compromising essential features.
White Edition for SFF Enthusiasts
The iGame B850I MINI W OC completes COLORFUL's iGame MINI OC lineup with a white alternative to the original black model. Both motherboards share the same hardware specifications and overclocking capabilities, allowing builders to choose their preferred aesthetic without sacrificing performance.
Whether paired with white graphics cards, cooling components, and chassis, or incorporated into a contrasting build, the iGame B850I MINI W OC offers enthusiasts another option for creating powerful and visually coordinated small form factor PCs.
SpecificationsPricing and Availability
The COLORFUL iGame B850I MINI W OC motherboard is set to launch in China on November 23rd, 2026, with global availability expected to follow shortly after. It will retail for 1,599 RMB (approximately US$239). Contact your local COLORFUL representative for regional pricing and availability.

articles.title: AI Inference Providers Failed to Detect Hacking and Prompt Theft, Says Dragos
articles.text:
Threat actors breached at least three AI inference providers and stole customer prompts, but none detected the intrusions until they were notified, according to cybersecurity firm Dragos.
AI inference providers host AI models and sell access to them through APIs. The hacks were detected after a team led by Dragos chief research officer HD Moore sent out roughly two million prompts to widely used AI services between July and November.
These prompts contained a unique, trackable bait such as URLs, hostnames, and credentials, including AWS keys. The security firm then set up a monitoring system to see whether anyone used the bait information in the wild, which meant the prompt had been compromised.
Dragos soon found evidence indicating that someone had stolen information from one of the tested AI inference providers. 
“Although our prompts were bait, they were processed along with real customer requests, and those were almost certainly copied too,” Moore noted.
The biggest breach involved roughly 200 AWS test keys sent to a provider, which were stolen in late October.
“Some of the stolen keys came from requests that the provider rejected before a model ever ran – this tells us that the attacker was copying requests at the provider’s front door, and not somewhere deeper in the inference stack,” Moore said.
Dragos saw the attackers checking which stolen keys worked, then trying to use them to obtain valuable data from the associated accounts.
The attackers have not been identified, but Dragos said one adversary appears to have hacked two of the providers at the same time, using secrets stolen from both from a single rented server.
OpenRouter, an AI gateway that sends customer requests to dozens of inference providers, was indirectly affected. The company said its own systems were not breached, but it removed three unnamed providers in response to the incident.
OpenRouter also listed security notices published by several providers. It did not say whether these are among the three it removed.
The list includes confidential AI cloud provider Phala, which said an attacker compromised a server running a DeepSeek model served via OpenRouter. It admitted that requests sent between October 21 and November 8 should be considered exposed.
AI cloud platform Together AI revealed that an AI coding agent leaked credentials on GitHub, which were then used to obtain stored prompt samples. Model hosting platform Novita and inference platform Atlas Cloud traced potential exposure to requests that reached the API of model developer MiniMax.
